scope: Follow-up bounded terminology audit after v1.14.4: c37–c64 overview fields, with targeted contextual checks for c39/c41/c42/c45/c50/c51/c54/c63. No dist or earlier audit file edited.
limits: This is terminology research, not certification of all current game balance or all Korean tooltips.
Official web archive is primarily 2021–2022; a historical official name does not verify current numerical effects.
Search-index excerpts from the official Facebook account are explicitly distinguished from directly read official pages.
Wiki transcriptions remain indirect; no candidate was upgraded merely because a wiki labels its text an in-game tooltip.

confirmedFindings.decision: 암호 페이지 already adopted is now supported by direct official text. Add 걸리버 여행기 to the first description of shrinking. Preserve the historical spelling variant only in research.
Use the full official skill name for synchronization when naming the ability.
Current paired terminology is supported. Use these names instead of only red/blue in advice, when color references identify these modes.
Keep separate. Do not globally expand generic 비늘 into any one skill name.
Use the explicit item name on first mention; later generic 지팡이 is ordinary prose.
Keep 퉁소. 기계 퉁소 remains a tooltip candidate without new primary confirmation.
